description: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of three models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on two tasks: Audio and Noise, as evaluated in the MMAR benchmark. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 60 with a dashed horizontal line at 30%, while the horizontal axis lists the model names. For each model, two bars are shown: a blue bar for Audio and a purple bar for Noise. Qwen2-Audio-Instruct achieves an accuracy of approximately 30% for Audio and 23% for Noise. Audio-Reasoner shows a higher accuracy of about 37% for Audio and 30% for Noise. Qwen-2.5-Omni achieves the highest performance, with approximately 57% accuracy for Audio and 36% for Noise. The legend in the top-left corner identifies the color coding for the two tasks.
